security.reset.verifyAgain: Waqti badan ayaa qaatay, sidaas darteed koodh cusub ayaan kuu dirnay.
security.reset.idSubtitle: Aqoonsiga Zapp Pay hubisay markii akoonkaaga la ansixiyay.
security.reset.idWrong: Taasi isma laha. Isku dayada harsan: {{count}}.
security.reset.idLocked: Jawaabo khaldan oo badan. Berri isku day, ama u tag taageerada Zapp Pay adigoo wata aqoonsigaaga.
security.reset.needsSupport: PIN-kaaga app-ka laguma dejin karo. U tag taageerada Zapp Pay adigoo wata aqoonsigaaga.
security.reset.limit: PIN-kaaga dhowaan marar badan ayaad dib u dejisay. La xiriir taageerada Zapp Pay.
security.reset.failed: PIN-ka dib looma dejin karin. Isku day mar kale.
security.reset.doneMessage: PIN-kaaga cusub waa diyaar. Ammaankaaga darteed, bixinta iyo dirista lacagta waa la hakiyay ilaa {{time}}.
security.lock.title: Geli PIN-kaaga
security.lock.subtitle: Si aad u furto Zapp Pay Merchant.
security.lock.lockedFor: PIN khaldan oo badan. Isku day mar kale {{seconds}} ilbiriqsi kadib.
security.lock.checkFailed: PIN-ka lama hubin karin. Hubi xiriirkaaga oo isku day mar kale.
security.title: PIN-ka iyo amniga
security.appLockHint: Weydii PIN-kaaga marka app-ka la furo, iyo kadib daqiiqad aad ka maqnayd.
security.footnote: Zapp Pay weligeed PIN-kaaga kuuma weydiin doonto taleefan, SMS ama shakhsi ahaan. Haddii qof sidaas sameeyo, waa khiyaano.
devices.title: Taleefannada la aamino
devices.intro: Taleefannadan waxay ku geli karaan PIN-kaaga halkii koodh SMS ah. Ka saar kuwa aadan aqoon, kadibna beddel PIN-kaaga.
devices.securityDesc: Arag taleefannada ku geli kara PIN-kaaga, oo mid ka saar.
devices.empty: Akoonkan ma laha taleefan loo aaminay gelitaanka PIN-ka. App-kan wuxuu ku galaa koodh SMS ah; taleefannada isticmaala app-ka Zapp Pay ee lambarkan halkan ayay ka muuqdaan.
devices.loadFailed: Taleefannadaada lama soo rari karin. Hubi xiriirkaaga oo isku day mar kale.
devices.renameFailed: Magaca lama beddeli karin. Isku day mar kale.
devices.removeMessage: Wuxuu u baahan doonaa koodh SMS ah si uu mar kale u galo. Taleefannada kale oo dhan sidoo kale waa laga saarayaa.
devices.removeFailed: Lama saari karin. Isku day mar kale.
consent.title: Kahor intaadan bilaabin
consent.body: Si aad u isticmaasho Zapp Pay, fadlan akhri oo aqbal Shuruudaha Adeegga iyo Siyaasadda Arrimaha Gaarka ah. Waxay sharxayaan sida lacagtaada iyo xogtaada loo maareeyo.
consent.updatedBody: Fadlan akhri Shuruudaha Adeegga iyo Siyaasadda Arrimaha Gaarka ah ee la cusboonaysiiyay oo aqbal si aad u sii isticmaasho Zapp Pay.
consent.failed: Lama kaydin karin. Hubi xiriirkaaga oo isku day mar kale.
consent.updateApp: Shuruudahan mar kale ayay isbeddeleen. Cusboonaysii app-ka si aad u aragto nuqulka ugu dambeeyay.
changePhone.title: Beddel lambarka taleefanka
changePhone.securityDesc: SIM cusub ma heshay? U wareeji akoonkaaga iyo lacagtiisa lambarkaaga cusub.
changePhone.numberSubtitle: Akoonkaagu hadda wuxuu isticmaalaa {{phone}}. Geli lambarka cusub, oo leh koodhka dalka.
changePhone.haveOld: Weli SMS waan ka heli karaa lambarkaygii hore
changePhone.lostOld: Lambarkaygii hore ma hayo mar dambe
changePhone.pauseNote: Ammaankaaga darteed, dirista lacagta waa la hakiyaa 7 maalmood kadib isbeddelka. Helitaanka lacagta saameyn kuma laha.
changePhone.idSubtitle: Aqoonsigaaga la xaqiijiyay, maadaama aadan SMS ka heli karin lambarkaagii hore.
changePhone.pinSubtitle: Geli PIN-kaaga si aad u oggolaato isbeddelka.
changePhone.taken: Lambarkaas horeba wuxuu leeyahay akoon Zapp Pay ah.
changePhone.needsProof: Xaqiiji lambarkaagii hore, ama geli 4-ta ugu dambeysa ee aqoonsigaaga.
changePhone.idWrong: Taasi kuma eka aqoonsigaaga. Isku dayada harsan: {{count}}.
changePhone.needsSupport: Lambarkaaga app-ka laguma beddeli karo. U tag taageerada Zapp Pay adigoo wata aqoonsigaaga.
changePhone.expired: Waqti badan ayaa qaatay. Dib u bilow.
changePhone.locked: Isku day khaldan oo badan. Sug in yar, ama dib u deji PIN-kaaga.
changePhone.codeWrong: Koodhkaasi sax ma aha. Hubi fariinta oo isku day mar kale.
changePhone.failed: Lambarkaaga lama beddeli karin. Isku day mar kale.
changePhone.doneMessage: Akoonkaagu hadda wuxuu isticmaalaa {{phone}}. Dirista lacagta waa la hakiyay ilaa {{date}}.
errors.sendingPaused: Dirista lacagta waa la hakiyay muddo kadib dib-u-dejinta PIN-ka ama beddelka lambarka taleefanka. Helitaanku wuu shaqeynayaa.
deletionPending.title: Akoonka waa la tirtiri doonaa
deletionPending.subtitle: Waxaa la tirtiri doonaa {{date}}. Geli PIN-kaaga si aad u haysato.
deletionPending.signOut: Ka bax oo ha la tirtiro
